name: sabu-ai-ops
description: Free-first multi-provider AI incident monitoring and phone assistant

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check scripts/first-deploy.mjs && npm test

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: One-time random setup token (minimum 32 characters). NEVER publish it in a repository. Enter during Cloudflare deployment, then use on the first screen.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Random 32-byte base64 key for encrypting provider credentials. Preserve this secret permanently and do not rotate without migrating stored credentials.
